verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own MCP server is documented to "work with segments" and lets AI clients "build segments". Its CLI claims "full access" to workspaces via the Journeys UI API, and the App API is said to "fetch data". So programmatic segment creation and management is plausibly first-party. However, no evidence documents specific endpoints for creating or updating segments, tags or lists, or for reading back exact segment membership. Missing for 10: documented segment create/update API endpoints, a documented way to list segment or list members programmatically, explicit tag or list management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: read workspace data, create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and more
your AI client can then do the work for you: build segments, draft emails, or report on how your messages perform.
The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.
It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command
To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
